take_homes: I tell the AI what report I want, it builds a helper, and I check it and fix it. The 25-minute exercise was useful.
Make the AI say which file each claim comes from, otherwise it invents things.
Everyone had access to everything but only used a little. Same with our reports.

monday.move: Describe the weekly depot delay report in four lines and have the AI build a helper from a sample file. Only if the data can be exported without IT.
monday.who: me, maybe one depot manager to look at the result
monday.when: Tuesday morning, after the depot call
monday.stop_condition: If I can't get the data out without asking IT, I stop
monday.blocker: The reporting lives in a system I can't export from, and I have no time

misconception.why: The first exercise showed AI building a report-type helper, not only a customer chatbot. The forum part did nothing for operations, so it is only a little shaken.

one_line: The first half-hour, building a small helper, was ok. Then 70 minutes of agents arguing in a folder, and I could have been at the depot.
